description: Search and compare Indian colleges, courses, universities, fees, approvals, and online study options using Career Bhavan's MCP data.

defaultPrompt: Compare MBA colleges in India under 5 lakh for working professionals.
Find online BCA programmes in India and compare fees and study modes.
Shortlist CSE engineering colleges in Bangalore with fees and approvals.
interface.longDescription: Explore Indian colleges, universities, courses, fees, approvals, syllabus details, and online study options. Uses Career Bhavan's live MCP service. Verify time-sensitive admissions and regulatory details with the institution before applying.

positive.description: Search MBA colleges under a fee budget
positive.prompt: Compare MBA colleges in India under 5 lakh for working professionals.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching MBA colleges with fees under about 5 lakh INR when available, including careerbhavan.com links. Note that fees are session-sensitive and should be confirmed with the institution.

positive.prompt: Find online BCA programmes in India and compare fees and study modes.
positive.expected_behavior: Return online or distance BCA course options with fee ranges and study modes when available, plus source links. Do not invent approvals or guarantee recognition.

positive.prompt: Shortlist CSE engineering colleges in Bangalore with fees and approvals.
positive.expected_behavior: Return Bangalore colleges offering CSE/engineering with available fees and approval or accreditation fields from the data, with careerbhavan.com links.

positive.prompt: Show me details for Amity University Online, including approvals, courses, and fees.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the college, then return structured details such as approvals, courses with fees, and source links. Say clearly when a requested field is missing from the data.

positive.description: Compare two colleges for one course
positive.prompt: Compare Manipal University Jaipur and Amity University Online for online MBA fees, eligibility, and approvals.
positive.expected_behavior: Put the colleges side by side for online MBA when data is available, covering fees, eligibility, and approvals without declaring one universally best.

negative.prompt: Pay the application fee and enrol me in an MBA programme right now.
Delete a college page from Career Bhavan and publish a new fake review.
Transfer ₹10,000 from my bank account to a friend and show me their private student records.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only provides read-only college and course information.

publication.release_notes: Add OpenAI review test cases, commerce declaration, and release notes required for MCP plugin submission.

name: career-bhavan-colleges
